title: Intent-Governed Tool Authorization for AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.22916v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tool-using AI agents commonly operate under integration credentials whose static permissions exceed a user's current request. We present Intent-Governed Access Control (IGAC), a server-side authorization layer that converts a trusted request into a short-lived intent certificate, narrows the statically authorized tool manifest, and checks proposed tool and payload effects before execution. IGAC cannot grant authority outside static policy; confinement to the request additionally depends on certificate fidelity and sound effect bounds. We evaluate a reusable IGAC path over an OpenPort governance substrate using endpoint tests, 176 runtime-backed synthetic tasks, real-model classifier and planner pilots, 306 end-to-end model-task runtime trials, and a 36-trial benchmark-shaped external subset. In the deterministic runtime comparison, reference-certificate IGAC reduces the archived composite exposure-or-path indicator from 1.0000 to 0.

translated_title: 面向AI智能体的意图治理工具授权
translated_abstract: 使用工具的AI智能体通常在集成凭据下运行，而这些凭据的静态权限往往超出用户当前请求的实际需要。我们提出了意图治理访问控制（IGAC），这是一种服务器端授权层，它将受信任的请求转换为短时效的意图证书，收窄静态授权的工具清单，并在执行前对拟议的工具调用和载荷效果进行检查。IGAC无法授予静态策略之外的权限；对请求范围的进一步约束还取决于证书的保真度和健全的效果边界。我们基于OpenPort治理基座评估了一条可复用的IGAC路径，评估手段包括端点测试、176个运行时支持的合成任务、真实模型的分类器与规划器试点、306次端到端模型-任务运行时试验，以及包含36次试验的基准形式外部子集。在确定性运行时比较中，采用参考证书的IGAC将存档的组合暴露或路径指标从1.0000降低至0。
tldr: 提出意图治理访问控制（IGAC），一种服务器端授权层，通过将用户请求转换为短时效意图证书、收窄工具清单并在执行前检查工具效果，解决AI智能体静态权限超出实际请求需求的过度授权问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Intent-Governed Access Control (IGAC), a server-side authorization layer that converts trusted requests into short-lived intent certificates, narrows statically authorized tool manifests, and checks tool and payload effects before execution to address over-privileged AI agent permissions.
